groups.defect: In impl.go, the device ID is written to localCache before CreateOrUpdateDevice runs. When the write fails with ErrDeviceLimitReached, the entry stays in the cache, so a retry takes the cache fast path, skips the device-limit check and gets authenticated.

answer.reasoning: Both suggestions describe the same defect: the cache entry is set before persistence and is not removed when the device-limit write fails, so retries bypass the limit. Both propose the same fix: cache only after a successful write, or evict on error. s_26a094d0 is anchored at the new error return in TagDevice (lines 144-147). s_445423dd is anchored at the cache-population code (lines 80-95) in the same file. The two anchors are in different functions, so the kind is cross_location. One edit to the cache handling fixes both, so needsUnifiedComment is false. Whether to call it same_location or cross_location is debatable, but there's no doubt they are duplicates.
